title: Exploring plot styles
text: Setting style = "plain" (default) creates output resembles original “flametree” images: colours vary along body trees, “leaves” drawn.

title: Exploring plot styles
text: Setting style = "voronoi" creates plot tree bodies uniform colour, coloured “leaves” drawn top trees using Voronoi tessellation locations terminal nodes. Note computing tessellation computationally expensive, likely produce errors many nodes.
code: flametree_grow(time = 6, trees = 5) |>    flametree_plot(     palette = shades,      style = "voronoi"   )

title: Exploring plot styles
text: style = "nativeflora" style creates plot tree bodies rendered thin segments, proportion segments removed, small points drawn end terminal segment.
code: flametree_grow(   time = 10,    trees = 12,    shift_x = spark_nothing() ) |>    flametree_plot(     palette = shades,      style = "nativeflora"   )

title: Exploring plot styles
text: Setting style = "wisp" similar “nativeflora” style, segments removed, tree body wider base.

title: Exploring plot styles
text: Setting style = "minimal" produces variant use curved segments.
code: flametree_grow(time = 10, trees = 5) |>    flametree_plot(     palette = shades,      style = "minimal"   )

title: Exploring plot styles
text: Finally, user sets style = "themegray" result plot uses traditional gray theme used ggplot2.
code: flametree_grow(time = 10, trees = 5) |>    flametree_plot(     palette = shades,      style = "themegray"   )

title: Generate the data specifying a flametree — flametree_grow
text: output flametree_grow() tibble following columns: coord_x, coord_y, id_tree, id_time, id_path, id_leaf, id_pathtree, id_step, seg_deg, seg_len, seg_col, seg_wid. row tibble specifies single point: every curved segment defined three rows. two "coord" columns numeric variables specify location point . "id" columns used indicators various kinds. id_tree column contains numbers specifying tree point belongs , similarly id_time column numeric identifier specifies time point point generated (.e., iteration generative process). id_step column contains number (0, 1, 2) indicating whether point first point, midpoint, end point relevant curved segment tree. addition, two identifier columns used denote segments . id_path column numeric, assigns value 1 "first" segment (.e., lowest part tree trunk) every tree, values increasing numerically subsequent segment. id_leaf column TRUE terminal segments: grown final iteration process, earlier segment whose growth stopped early prune argument. Values id_path uniquely identify segment within tree, multiple trees generated multiple segments id_path value. unique identifier across trees needed, use id_pathtree column, character vector constructed pasting id_path id_tree values string, underscore separator character. addition two coordinate columns six identifier columns, data generated flametree_grow() contains four "seg" columns intended map onto different visual characteristics plot. seg_deg column specifies orientation segment, whereas seg_len denotes length segment, seg_col specifies colour (numeric value interpreted palette), seg_wid specifies width segment. Note information use used differently flametree_plot() function, depending style plot generated.

title: Generate the data specifying a flametree — flametree_grow
text: Generative art created flametree visualisation data structure created calling flametree_grow(). underlying algorithm iterative branching process: tree starts single vertical segment, multiple new segments added end first iteration. multiple iterations creates tree-like structure. user can control iterative process unfolds. setting seed argument random number generator reset using set.seed(). trees argument specifies number trees create using process, time argument specifies many iterations branching process run (least two), split argument specifies many new segments (least one) created time branching occurs. Setting split = 1 disables branching altogether, producing single winding path per tree rather branching structure. number segments grows factor split every one time iterations, size resulting data grows exponentially: roughly trees * split ^ time segments created total (represented three rows output). Large values time /split (especially combination large number trees) can therefore produce large data frames may exhaust available memory; flametree_grow() warn likely happen. new segment created, size orientation controlled scale angle arguments. scale argument takes vector least two positive numbers. One numbers selected random whenever new segment created, length new segment equal length "parent" segment created, multiplied scaling factor. orientation new segment controlled angle argument analogous way. Every time new segment generated, one angles (interpreted degrees, radians) selected random. orientation new segment equal orientation parent segment plus sampled angle. Like scale argument, angle must contain least two values. remaining arguments (seg_col, seg_wid, shift_x, shift_y, prune) take functions input, used control colours (seg_col) width (seg_wid) segments created, horizontal (shift_x) vertical (shift_y) displacement trees, probability growth given shoot pruned (prune). Functions passed arguments take four inputs: coord_x, coord_y, id_tree, id_time. function takes variables input can used purpose. However, convenience, four "spark" functions provided can used create functions suitable purpose: spark_linear(), spark_decay(), spark_random(), spark_nothing(). prune argument interpreted probability: iteration, every newly created shoot endpoint passed prune function, pruned (.e., stops growing ) probability. segment shoot already grown still included output marked leaf node (see id_leaf ), descendants grown . default, spark_nothing(), always returns 0 therefore disables pruning entirely. constant pruning probability can obtained , example, spark_linear(constant = 0.2), space- time-varying pruning can created using spark_decay() custom function. functions documented help files. give example, default behaviour flametree_grow() adds random horizontal displacement tree give impression multiple trees growing side side. suppress horizontal displacement, set shift_x = spark_nothing().

text: flametree_plot() function provides several ways visualise data created generative system implemented flametree_grow(). background argument sets background colour image, either string specifying RGB hex colour (e.g., "#000000") colour recognised R (see colours() function details). Analogously, palette argument vector colours. However, palette argument  interpreted slightly differently depending style plot created, discussed . set style resulting plot, pass one following style names: "plain" (default), "voronoi", "wisp", "nativeflora", "minimal", "themegray" (British spelling, "themegrey", also accepted). Plots "plain" style following properties. Branches trees vary width using seg_wid data column. branch shown curved segment created using geom_bezier2(), colour segments mapped seg_col column data. leaves drawn. style, elements palette used create continuous n-colour gradient using scale_colour_gradientn(). Plots "voronoi" style draw shape tree way plain style, except segments vary colour rendered using geom_bezier() instead geom_bezier2(). Unlike plain style, stylised "leaves" drawn constructing Voronoi tessellation terminal nodes tree. Note computing tessellation computationally expensive likely produce errors many nodes (typically time parameter flametree_grow() large). interpretation palette argument slightly different: first element palette used set colour trees, rest palette colours used create gradient palette used colour tiles depicted Voronoi tessellation. style = "nativeflora" style creates plot tree branches rendered thin segments, proportion segments removed, small points drawn end terminal segment. width branches vary (.e., seg_wid ignored) colour branches constant within tree, vary across trees, ignoring continuous valued seg_col variable using id_tree variable . plain style, palette colours used define n-colour gradient. "wisp" style similar nativeflora, segments removed, width branches mapped seg_wid. uses first two elements palette: first element specifies colour branches, second element specifies colour leaf dots. final two styles simplifications styles. "minimal" style similar plain style use curved segments, relying geom_path() draw branches. "themegray" style , ignores palette argument entirely, rendering trees black, set default gray background specified ggplot2 theme_gray() function.

title: flametree 0.2.0
text: Reintroduces prune support, removed prior 0.1.3 release. flametree_grow() gains prune argument: spark function (like seg_col, seg_wid, shift_x, shift_y) controls probability given shoot stops growing early. default, spark_nothing(), disables pruning reproduces prior behaviour exactly. Pruned shoots keep segment already grew, segment marked leaf (id_leaf), produces descendants. Also relaxes split allow value 1, disables branching altogether produces single winding path per tree (#19). ft__check_colour() now validates background palette arguments flametree_plot() colours R actually recognises (via grDevices::col2rgb()), rather checking character vectors. Invalid colours (e.g. "##f6b6a6") now throw informative error flametree_plot() , rather failing deep inside grid graphics code (#17). flametree_grow() now warns requested time, split, trees combination expected produce large data frame (row count grows trees * split ^ time), since common cause “allocate vector” memory errors (#18). Adds two missing input validation checks: flametree_grow()’s trees argument (previously unchecked entirely, e.g. trees = 2.5 silently misbehaved invalid input failed cryptic low-level errors), flametree_save()’s plot argument (previously, passing anything ggplot object either failed cryptic error , case plot = NULL, silently saved unrelated plot via ggplot2::last_plot() instead erroring). Switches internal code, @examples, README.Rmd, vignettes use base R native pipe |> instead magrittr pipe %>%, adds Depends: R (>= 4.1.0) accordingly. %>% operator re-exported magrittr unaffected still available backward compatibility. Rewords Description field DESCRIPTION: growth algorithm stochastic branching process, formal L-system (implies deterministic rewriting grammar), earlier description technically misleading. Also fixes grammatical mismatch field (“generating data structures visualise ” → “…visualising ”). Sets spell checking package documentation, using spelling package. Sets Language: en-GB DESCRIPTION (package consistently uses British spellings “colour” “visualise”), adds inst/WORDLIST accepted technical terms. Along way, fixes handful genuine typos found spell check: “tesselation” → “tessellation”, “wdith” → “width”, “abranching” → “branching” (flametree_plot() flametree_grow()’s documentation). documentation clarity pass: fixes copy-paste error @param y description sparks functions (previously said “horizontal” x y); removes stray backtick flametree_grow()’s @return docs; documents flametree_plot(style = "themegray") also accepts British spelling "themegrey"; updates stale comment checks.R referred prune removed, since reintroduced; , vignettes, mentions prune spark argument (previously omitted) fixes couple typos (“wheras”, missing article, another instance “tesselation”) weren’t caught spell check vignettes currently excluded .

text: Fixes bug “wisp” style segments grouped id_path instead id_pathtree, causing segments different trees happened share id_path value incorrectly joined together (#14).

title: flametree 0.1
text: First CRAN release. Consolidates several separate, inconsistent plotting systems (ashtree, wisptree, voronoitree, original flametree functions) single, unified interface package still uses: flametree_grow() generate underlying data, flametree_plot() render chosen style (“plain”, “minimal”, “themegray”, “voronoi”, “wisp”, “nativeflora”). Introduces “spark function” system (spark_linear(), spark_decay(), spark_random(), spark_nothing()) controlling segment colour, segment width, horizontal/vertical displacement growth. Adds id_leaf data structure returned flametree_grow(), identifying terminal segments. Renames unexported functions use consistent ft__ prefix, adds initial test suite package documentation site (via pkgdown).

title: flametree 0.0.1
text: Early development version, predating unified flametree_grow()/flametree_plot() interface introduced 0.1. Establishes core data structure representing grown tree, simplifies internal API default parameter values.
